listing_fee.behavior: Client-supplied p_fee is stored with no policy lookup in create_listing; buy_listing uses stored fee when 0 <= fee <= price, otherwise recomputes vexforge_market_fee(price).

buyer_fee.evidence: buy_listing debits buyer exactly v_price; no additional buyer-fee ledger entry is present.

seller_fee.treasury_destination: No treasury row/write in buy_listing; fee ledger player_id is NULL.

reservation_and_locking: create_listing FOR UPDATE locks player_cards row and sets locked=true, listed=true.
buy_listing FOR UPDATE locks market_listings, transfers player_card ownership, marks listing sold.
cancel_listing FOR UPDATE locks seller listing and clears listing/card lock.
